summary: Round-3 scaling verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 new pytests pass covering GET /api/bills/property/{pid}/summary (all-time + month-scoped, month list, per-type counts sum to all), paginated /api/bills envelope with tenant/property enrichment, no-duplicate pagination, and property-scoped tenant typeahead search. Frontend: Tenants list unchanged and correct (25/page, 'Page 1 of 12', no duplicates page 1 vs 2, search resets). PropertyBills drill-down renders 4 stat cards (Outstanding/Collected/Expected/Bills) from the summary endpoint, month prev/next/today + month chips update the figures, all 5 tabs render with server-computed counts (matches expected: Electricity 0, Diesel 0, Service_charge 2, Other 18, All 20 for Utako in Jul 2026), all 4 dialog buttons (add-service-charge/other-bill/electricity/diesel) open, and both typeaheads (sc-tenant, other-tenant) function: opening reveals sc-tenant-input, typing 'a' returned 9 property-scoped options with data-testid sc-tenant-option-<id>; selecting sets the tenant, sc-submit is present. Same trigger/input/option testids work for the Other-bill dialog. Bill row actions (bill-pay/mark-paid/mark-unpaid/edit/delete) exist on every rendered row.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_bills (line 3283-3295): pagination envelope OK, but the non-paginated path still does .to_list(5000000) — same scale risk noted in iteration 2. Recommend deprecating the unpaginated path once the frontend fully migrates.

property_bills_summary computes months via aggregation on every summary call. For properties with many bills, add an index on {owner_id:1, property_id:1, tenant_id:1, due_date:1} if not already present.
server.py is now 4853 lines — modularization still recommended (tenants/bills/reports routers).
seed_data_creation: None. Utako Estate on Jul 2026 had 20 bills (<50), so bills-pagination bar was not shown on the frontend for that view — this is the expected behavior per PRD; the paginated envelope is validated by backend pytest (page=1, page=2, disjoint ids).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New pytest file test_property_bills_and_typeahead.py adds coverage for the round-3 endpoints. Tenants pagination stability fix from iteration_2 still holds. If retesting frontend pagination bar, pick a property/month with >50 bills (per problem statement, one property has 135 all-time bills — use ?month=all in the URL query if surfaced, or seed more bills). Other-tenant typeahead was validated indirectly (same component as sc-tenant, which returned 9 results). All row-level bill action testids exist and are consistent (bill-pay-<id>, bill-mark-paid-<id>, bill-mark-unpaid-<id>, bill-edit-<id>, bill-delete-<id>, bill-row-<id>).
